id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9868: "That you are the hero who saved the country is known to me, Charlotte, and the witch. That's enough.

id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9ae8: "Oh, it's been a while. Glad to see you again. Have you met Charlotte yet?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9b98: "...I'm investigating the mysterious illness spreading in this land lately. Charlotte can explain in detail.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9cd8: "I'm studying the Gold Plague too, but no book records anything like it.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9da4: "This is merely a hypothesis... The Gold Plague may be a new illness created by some evil being with a purpose.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|9f08: "After the Gold Plague, an army of gold monsters attacked and took the golden people and the residents' valuables...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a050: "...Hmm. Perhaps the mastermind commanding those monsters spread the Gold Plague to gather gold.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a134: "But if so, that one has fearsome power. {var:1}, be careful.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a214: "To pass this on to later generations, I'm thinking of writing a book on the Gold Plague.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a30c: "The Luminary and Gold... The Terrifying Gold Plague... The Cursed Gold Soldiers... Golden Atonement... Now, what title?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a498: "The Dark One was defeated by the Luminary, and Yggdrasil revived...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a548: "To witness such a historic event in my lifetime is a joy even as a scholar.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a730: "Ah, it's you. It's been a while. There's a rumor that the holy beast Moon Baba you defeated has revived...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a7ec: "That's not all. I hear the revived Moon Baba sits in Mirlean Forest and attacks visitors!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a8d8: "By my research, the holy beast Moon Baba would never act so. It must be tainted by evil power.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|a9cc: "I've heard that the book 'Guardian of the Forest' in the Ancient Library tells how to free Moon Baba from evil power.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|aae4: "I can't leave it like that. Go to the Ancient Library, read 'Guardian of the Forest,' and restore Moon Baba.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|acac: "Ah, it's you. Do you need something?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ad10: "...What? Defeating the evil Moon Baba reborn it as the holy beast Moon Baba?!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|adb0: "To create a new Moon Baba by your own power... As expected of the one who beat the witch.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ae74: "The people of Sniflheim have long revered Moon Baba as the forest guardian who brings bounty.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b0ac: "The people of Sniflheim have long revered Moon Baba as the forest guardian who brings bounty.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|af70: "These are troubled times, but I hope the new Moon Baba brings bountiful harvests as the world's guardian.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b1a8: "These are troubled times, but I hope the new Moon Baba brings bountiful harvests as the world's guardian.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b420: "The queen turned into a witch... and the queen came out of the book! W-what's going on!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b4fc: "I don't know what's going on, but it seems everything worked out. I thank you.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b5ec: "Still, Charlotte, if you had worries, you could have consulted me. Was I unreliable after all?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b718: "Lately the King of Heliodor has mobilized his army to hunt the Darkspawn, but our country stays neutral.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b818: "Our queen's policy is neutrality until firm evidence appears that the Luminary brings disaster to the world.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|b914: "Our queen is wise and doesn't believe baseless rumors. She inherited the late king's wise nature.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ba4c: "If you want to know the country's situation, ask the queen directly.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bb04: "It's serious, so I can't say it lightly.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bbbc: "You've heard the situation from the queen. We're also planning countermeasures against the Gold Plague.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bcac: "...But between us, we have no idea of the cause or cure. We can't save the queen or the people. How pathetic.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|be10: "Those gold monsters do as they please. But we have no clues to chase them and are at a loss.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|becc: "...Come to think of it, a soldier's report said the monsters rode a distinctive ship.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|bf98: "For ships, the Vikings living in the nearby cave might know something.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c088: "Whew, we seem to have protected the country from the Gold Plague. It's all thanks to {var:1}.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c124: "Sniflheim's people will never forget this debt!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c1d8: "Whew, peace has finally returned. We'll be busy again with reconstruction plans.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c2a0: "That we can do these policies for the people is all thanks to {var:1}. We look forward to your continued deeds.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c3b0: "Gah, {var:1}! Thank goodness you came! Save Sniflheim... Please save Sniflheim!!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c460: "Oh, forgive me! I lost my composure. The situation is urgent...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c528: "Please ask the queen about it. Anyway, only you can save this country now...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c628: "Whew... I hear the dread dragon was slain. I thought Sniflheim would fall, but we escaped that somehow...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c6f0: "If it had fallen, I'd have no face to show the late king who entrusted Charlotte to us.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|c91c: "Charlotte feels different from usual, or am I imagining it? She's scary...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ca00: "I thought Charlotte felt different, and a witch was disguised as her! If that witch harms the queen, I won't forgive her!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cb38: "In Sniflheim legend, the ice witch is a most terrifying witch. Can we really trust her?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cc50: "The other day the ice witch taught me how to do makeup. I thought she was bad, but not really.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cd1c: "I only ever trained soldiers and never wore makeup, so my girlish instincts woke up.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|ce10: "Come to think of it, Charlotte has become more stylish lately. Maybe Lizzlette's influence.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cefc: "Lizzlette taught me fashion, and lately I've become interested in jewelry and precious accessories.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|cfd0: "...But just then, a terrible illness spread. Now fashion is out of the question.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d0b8: "The Gold Plague, regardless of human or animal, turns the whole body gold. A truly terrifying illness.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d1a4: "Some suspect Lizzlette because of past events and being a witch, but I think she's unrelated.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d2dc: "Charlotte and Lizzlette together really make a picture. I feel even more like protecting them!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d3e4: "Lizzlette is amazing. She can change mystical smithing materials into other materials. Like an alchemist.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d4bc: "With Lizzlette's power, you might make a super strong weapon. Ask her if you're interested.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d740: "You're Charlotte's benefactor. I'll thank you honestly for saving the queen.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d7f8: "But saving Charlotte is our duty. Next time anything happens, we'll protect Charlotte.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|d918: "Damn, if I attack the witch, I'd hit the queen! Please step aside, Your Majesty!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|da18: "I'm uneasy about the witch, but since the queen trusts her, there's no need to worry much.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|dac4: "As long as the queen is safe, the country's stability remains.
